project_name: ORBIS - Orbital Risk & Behaviour Intelligence System
theme: Dark Aerospace Mission Control / Space Domain Awareness (SDA)
design_principles: High-Density Tactical Clarity: High-signal telemetry layouts with zero fluff.
Data-as-Art: The 3D Earth and real SGP4/ACI orbital tracks form the centerpiece of visual command.
Monochrome Canvas + High-Contrast Telemetry: Dark void (#050811, #0B1220) with precise status signaling (Cyan, Amber, Crimson, Emerald).
HUD Precision & Tactical Grid: Corner reticles, subtle scanlines, monospaced coordinate badges, and crisp 1px borders.

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-5 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-200 hover:border-cyan-500/40

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
elements: ORBIS Emblem & System Status Indicator (Live/SGP4 Sync)
Navigation Links: Command Dashboard, Satellite Catalog, Conjunction Screening, ACI Insights, ML Reliability, Analytics
Quick Telemetry Replay Controls (Time Scrub, UTC Clock)
User Profile / Demo Auth Status Badge (operator@orbis.local)

globe_centerpiece.container_style: relative w-full h-[600px] bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
globe_centerpiece.overlay_hud: Tactical reticles in corners, orbital speed readout, satellite filter pills (LEO/GEO/Debris/Active), search & select quick action bar.

data_tables.style: w-full text-left font-mono text-sm bg-slate-950/50 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden
data_tables.header_style: bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 font-semibold px-4 py-3 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs border-b border-slate-800

3d_earth_configuration.library: Three.js / React Three Fiber / Globe GL
3d_earth_configuration.earth_texture: High-res dark earth atmosphere with specular nighttime city lights & atmospheric glow
3d_earth_configuration.orbital_rendering: Real-time rendering of satellites, debris, and conjoined trajectory paths driven directly from backend API endpoints GET /api/objects and GET /api/positions
3d_earth_configuration.interactivity: Orbit control, zoom to satellite on click, path projection line, TCA collision sphere rendering

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All buttons, navigation tabs, filter inputs, trajectory timeline controls, table pagination, and detail cards MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='conjunction-screen-btn', data-testid='object-search-input', data-testid='earth-globe-container').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA compliant contrast (4.5:1+) for all telemetry numbers and alert badges against dark panels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Connect directly to backend endpoints (GET /health, GET /api/summary, GET /api/objects, GET /api/objects/{object_id}, GET /api/positions, POST /api/conjunctions/screen, GET /api/conjunctions/history, ACI/ML endpoints).
Render the 3D Earth using backend satellite coordinates and trajectories.
Implement local demo authentication using credentials operator@orbis.local / ORBIS-DEMO-2026.
Ensure all interactive UI elements have data-testid attributes.
Preserve all scientific backend files, ACI logic, SGP4 propagators, ML models, and aci_output.csv.
Deliver a top 1% dark aerospace mission control experience with high-density data visualizations and slick HUD elements.
